reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited paragraphs support it: § 6(b)/§ 7(c) termination clauses require only payment of fees and expenses actually incurred or earned through the termination date, which is payment for work performed rather than a liquidated amount, kill fee or minimum-fee-on-termination.

No Customer-payable penalty, stipulated damages or late-payment interest appears in the cited compensation (p0014) or limitation-of-liability (p0035) text; the mutual cap at fees paid contains no LD carve-out, so the document sits at the preferred position.
Correctly no redline and no counterparty comment for a compliant finding; the rendered text is unchanged and deterministic checks are clean.
The rate-change right at p0014 is properly noted as a pricing observation rather than escalated as a deviation under this rule, consistent with the classification guidance.
